Greater Akron Chamber · Card Scanner · for the people who scan and check cards

This short guide is all you need to scan and review cards. Admin jobs (accounts, settings, the MC Trade import) are in the Admin & MC Trade Guide. All pictures use made-up demo cards.

1. What the scanner does

You take photos of business cards from an event. The scanner reads each card and fills in the name, company, email, phones and address. You check every card against its photo, fix anything wrong, and approve it. Approved cards are then exported to a file that goes into MC Trade.

Everything stays on the office computer. Nothing is sent to the internet.

2. Signing in

  1. Open the scanner (the GAC Card Scanner app, or the scanner address IT gave you in a browser).
  2. Type your own username and password, then click Sign in.
  • The first time, you choose your own password (at least 10 characters).
  • Always use your own account. Your initials are saved on every card you touch.
  • On a shared computer, click Sign out when you leave.
  • Forgot your password, or locked out after 5 wrong tries? Ask an admin.

3. Scanning cards

  1. Click Scan cards.
  2. Type a batch name after the event, for example Oct 15 Business After Hours.
  3. Drag the photos onto the dashed box, or click Choose photos or Choose a folder.

Good photos: one card per photo, flat on a dark table, filling the picture, no glare.

Each card takes a few seconds. You can start checking cards while the rest are still being read. In the Review queue, a batch that is still being read shows as "Spring Expo (5, being read…)".

Each finished card gets a tag:

Tag What it means
Looks good Nothing special. You still check it.
Needs a look Something needs a second look.
Not added The file was skipped. The reason is shown (not a photo, too small, or already scanned).

PDFs and iPhone photos. You can add HEIC photos (iPhone) and PDFs. A PDF is read one page at a time: the list shows Reading PDF: page 2 of 5…, and each card appears as its page is read. A scanner sheet with several cards on one page is split up: each card on the page becomes its own card. Up to 200 pages and 400 cards per file.

Cancel. Cancel stops the cards that are still waiting (and the rest of a PDF). Cards already added are kept.

Skip AI. Tick Skip AI before adding photos to scan faster at busy events. Those cards are not sent to the AI double-check; you can still ask for it on a card later.

"Reconnecting… your cards are safe." The scanner restarted or the connection dropped. Wait: it reconnects and sends waiting photos by itself.

4. The review queue

Click Review queue. It opens on your newest batch; More batches… in the drop-down shows the others. You see the Pending cards first. A red Blocked chip means the card has something to fix before it can be approved.

  • Tick Needs attention only to see just the cards with a problem. The reason is in plain words.
  • Click a name to open the card.

5. Checking a card

The photo is on the left. The details are on the right.

  1. Wait until the fields are white. Grey fields mean the card is still loading.
  2. Compare every field with the photo. Click the photo to zoom.
  3. Fix anything wrong by typing in the field. Yellow fields were hard to read, so look closely.
  4. Click Approve (or press A) when it's right. Click Reject (or press R) if it isn't a real contact.

Good to know:

  • The counter at the top says how many cards are left, for example "2 of 7 pending". When you finish the last one it says "0 pending left".
  • Saving… on a button means: wait a moment. Clicking twice does nothing extra.
  • Keys: press Esc, then A approve · R reject · J next · K previous · U undo.

When Approve says no

A red box Fix before approving lists every problem as soon as the card opens, and the fields turn red. Fix them, Save, and click Approve again.

Always needed: a first name (no digits in names), a full email, and phones with an area code (e.g. 330-555-0100). For softer warnings Approve asks for a short reason.

The card really says that? ("Confirm")

Sometimes the scanner thinks a word was misread (a garbled company, a job title like "Acc0unt"). If the card really says that:

  • Click Save, then Confirm next to the field, and type why (for example "printed like this on the card"). The field gets a ✓ confirmed tag.
  • Phone numbers can't be confirmed: fix them. For email, website or address, ask an admin.
  • If you change the value later, confirm it again.

"Nothing was saved"

If you see "Card … changed since you opened it… Nothing was saved", someone else changed this card. Your typing is still here. Reload, check, and save again.

6. AI suggestions (optional)

The top bar shows AI check: on or AI check: off. When it is on, a small AI on this computer re-reads hard cards and may suggest a fix. It never changes a card by itself.

For each row choose Use AI value or Keep current, then check it against the photo. You don't have to wait for the AI: you can approve now.

7. Duplicates

The scanner warns you in an orange box when a card may be a duplicate. What to do:

The box saysWhat to click
Same person twice in this batch (same email or phone)You must decide before approving. Click Same person to add any new details to the other card and drop this one, or reject one of the two cards.
Seen at another event (a look-alike in another batch)Only a warning. Click Same person to combine them, or Different person if you are sure they are two people.
May already be in MC TradeClick Different person: add as new contact, or reject the card if it is the same person and tell an admin.

Details lists every look-alike.

After one of the pair is rejected, the other card shows "May be the same person as card … (rejected, this batch)". That's only a hint. Check that the right card was kept, then approve.

If Approve says "This person was exported before", that person was already sent to MC Trade from another batch. Open that card to compare, or Approve it anyway if you're sure. You are asked this even while the AI is still checking the card. After Different person you are not asked about MC Trade again.

8. Approving many cards at once

In the queue, tick the cards (or the top box for all) and click Approve selected. Cards that still need fixing are skipped, and the box tells you why.

9. Undo and changing your mind

  • A message at the top confirms each action, with an Undo link.
  • ↶ Undo in the top bar (or U) reverses your last action. It works for your own actions from the last 24 hours.
  • On an approved or rejected card, Move back to pending reopens it.

When to ask an admin

Ask a scanner admin when:

  • you can't sign in, or you forgot your password
  • the red box says Ask an admin to confirm it (an email, website or address the card really prints that way)
  • you see "Photo deleted" and need the photo
  • a card is archived and can't be changed
  • the scanner says "can't connect" (the scanner window was closed)
  • you think someone is already in MC Trade
  • the Export page says blocked or refused, or you are asked to export
  • someone asks to be removed from our records
  • anything looks wrong: take a screenshot, note the card number (#), and tell the admin.
